judgment.notes: Compared all four M applications with their supplied statements and signatures. M008 uses the compact cylinder and continuity of d there. M009 uses the finite measure of C and the finite extended norm of the real B; M010 uses measurability of C and the indicator identity. For M002 the substitutions are F(r,x)=e(x,r), F'(r,x)=d(x,r), basepoint t0, s=stime and bound bnd, over the real field and codomain. F003 supplies the neighborhood, eventual ae strong measurability, base integrability, derivative-section measurability and both ae-first universal premises; F002 supplies integrability of bnd. The conclusions match F004 after unfolding E. No E application occurs.

For arbitrary t0>0, Ktime=[3t0/4,5t0/4] lies inside I and stime is a neighborhood of t0. The compact-cylinder bound controls d on C and the N002 vanishing controls it off C, producing an integrable bound independent of r in stime. The derivative assertion from N001 holds at every such r for every x; hence each ae-first premise is valid without interchanging quantifiers. M002 justifies the only derivative/integral interchange. N002 gives finite energy at every positive time, and S006 discharges all local choices to obtain exactly N003. The argument covers empty C and zero dimensions and uses no regularity at zero.
